## Manual fix needed beyond the automated trims: `zbin/`

At this commit, upstream introduced a new package, `zbin/` (compact binary
serialization for zod schemas - `bytes.ts`, `context.ts`, `zb.ts`, `index.ts`),
that lives at the **repo root**, not under `src/`. `core/Schemas.ts` and
`core/StatsSchemas.ts` import it via `../../zbin`, and it's genuinely part of
the `GameRunner.ts` reachable closure (used for player-clientID dictionary
encoding on the wire), so it can't just be trimmed away.

`scripts/vendor-engine.mjs`'s closure walker resolves imports relative to
each file, so `../../zbin` from `src/core/Schemas.ts` correctly finds and
copies `zbin/index.ts` etc. - but it copies them to `<this dir>/zbin/`, a
*sibling* of `src/`, because the resolved path itself carries a `../` that
escapes `src/` when joined onto the destination. That leaves the four zbin
files outside this tsconfig's `rootDir: "./src"`, and `tsc -b` fails with
`TS6059`/`TS6307` ("not under rootDir" / "not listed in the file list").

Fixed by hand (the script doesn't yet know this pattern - see its own
"brand-new client-only dependency" comment near the top of
`scripts/vendor-engine.mjs`): moved the four `zbin/*.ts` files into
`src/zbin/` in this tree, repointed the two importers' `../../zbin` to
`../zbin`, and added the usual vendoring header comments (content otherwise
byte-for-byte unmodified). Confirmed with `npx tsc -b` (both this project
alone and the full root build) after the fix.

**For the next re-vendoring pass**: check whether upstream still keeps
`zbin/` at the repo root (if it moved under `src/` this workaround becomes
unnecessary), and whether `scripts/vendor-engine.mjs`'s closure-copy step 3
has been taught to handle imports that resolve outside `srcRoot` generically
(it hadn't been, as of this pin).
